admission.justification: A future navigation cleanup must not replace the explicit marker return with outside subject selections and accidentally change walk/history semantics.

applicability: The recorded reviewer/reader 1 choice of MIK-R67@v2 rule18, or the explicit F07 resource ruling for one-spilled-history.
conditions: Use the review marker’s visible Back operation, not a separate browser-history subject entry.
Browser-history selection is an outside selection and can reset the walked tree; the review address deliberately has one history entry.
exclusions: No promise that the current marker return itself preserves every walked family; it restores its owned workspace state.
This is a source-bound future boundary, not a fresh runtime, visual, suite or independent MEMORY verdict.
statement: The browser's Back does not return from a followed marker. A selection made through browser history is an outside selection and would drop the walked tree (MIK-R39). The review has one history entry (MIK-R58 rule 8); the visible Back control returns from a marker.
